figures.title: Figure 1
figures.llm_description: Figure 1. Structure of Mn2(TTFTB). (a,b) Portions of structure viewed parallel and perpendicular to the crystallographic c axis showing nanoscale pores and π-stacked TTF columns, respectively. (c) A portion of the metal−carboxylate chain highlighting coordinating water molecules. Light blue, gray, red, yellow, and blue-green spheres represent H, C, O, S and Mn, respectively. Solvents and H atoms are omitted for clarity in (a,b).

figures.title: Figure 2
figures.llm_description: Figure 2. Electrical responses of M2(TTFTB) to adsorption and adsorption of water acquired at 298 K under humid N2 (higher current) and dry N2 (lower current) atmospheres acquired with single-crystal devices. DC voltage was 0.1 V. Current was monitored under flow of each gas until reaching equilibrium, which results in inhomogeneous time intervals before on and off states.
